REAL-WORLD MILEAGE

A 7-seater that sips like a hatchback.

These are the owner's own numbers, not brochure figures. With petrol prices where they are, the savings add up every single month.

How it works: a small 1.2 litre petrol engine only charges the battery. The wheels are always driven by the electric motor, so you get smooth, silent, instant EV torque without ever looking for a charger.

WINTER 21 km per litre
SUMMER (AC ON) 15 km per litre
Factory rating (Japan JC08 cycle): 26.2 km/L
EVERYTHING IT COMES WITH

The Serena e-POWER Highway Star V, pre-facelift C27

e-POWER drive

  • 100% electric motor drive, 136 hp and 320 Nm of instant torque
  • e-Pedal: speed up, slow down and stop with one pedal in city traffic
  • Drive modes: Normal, S and ECO
  • Manner mode for silent battery-only driving in neighbourhoods
  • Charge mode to top up the battery in advance
  • Regenerative braking recovers energy every time you slow down
  • Full-colour digital driver display with power and eco meter

Safety and driver assist

  • ProPILOT: adaptive cruise with steering assist for motorway driving
  • Intelligent Around View Monitor (360° cameras) with Moving Object Detection
  • Intelligent Parking Assist
  • Intelligent Room Mirror (camera rear-view mirror)
  • Intelligent Emergency Braking (automatic braking for cars and pedestrians)
  • Lane Departure Warning
  • High Beam Assist
  • Front and rear parking sensors
  • VDC stability control, ABS with EBD and Brake Assist
  • SRS front airbags
  • ISOFIX child seat anchors

Family space

  • 7 seats with two individual captain chairs in the second row
  • Long-slide second row and a walk-through aisle to the third row
  • Power sliding doors on both sides, with hands-free opening
  • Dual back door: open just the upper glass hatch in tight parking
  • Third row folds up to the sides for a huge flat boot
  • Best-in-class cabin room for its size, with easy low step-in

Comfort and style

  • Highway Star aero body kit, bumpers and side skirts
  • Blue e-POWER grille accents and badges
  • LED headlights and front fog lamps
  • Rear roof spoiler and tinted rear glass
  • Automatic climate control
  • Intelligent Key with push-button start
  • Genuine Nissan navigation screen and steering wheel controls
  • Door visors and genuine Serena floor mats
  • Recently fitted Yokohama ADVAN dB tyres (worth Rs 1 lac)
